_doc: The front page's 'Since December 2025' section. commits: commits per month to the project's private repository (git log on main, counted 2026-11-06; the last month is partial, to 'counted'). milestones: dated, each from the private build log or git history, rewritten under public/AGENTS.md's Boundary.
milestones: CAN-B identified as fault-tolerant CAN and the bus adapter chosen; the Ultimate-NAG52 transmission controller ordered.
The in-car gateway designed: a Raspberry Pi on both CAN buses and the engine ECU's K-line.
The Jetson's first live camera detections, YOLO26 on TensorRT.
comma's driving model runs on the Jetson at 20 Hz on the truck's camera.
A closed-loop simulator built from the truck's recorded drives.
The transmission runs a custom Ultimate-NAG52 firmware build; the object and free-ground models run beside the driving model.
Every new comma driving model is tested on the truck's drives as it is released.
The gateway drives the factory cruise control over CAN.
The engine ECU runs patched firmware that accepts a torque request on CAN.
